list.name: wordle
list.title: Wordle
list.blurb: Six guesses at a five-letter word. Say it or type it.

list.name: sudoku
list.title: Sudoku
list.blurb: The grid on the wall, the digits from the phone. Easy, medium or hard.

list.name: connections
list.title: Connections
list.blurb: Sixteen words, four groups of four. Four mistakes allowed.

list.name: spellingbee
list.title: Spelling Bee
list.blurb: Seven letters, one in the middle. Say words of four or more.

list.name: letterboxed
list.title: Letter Boxed
list.blurb: Twelve letters round a square. Chain words until all are used.

list.name: strands
list.title: Strands
list.blurb: A grid of letters hiding a themed set. Say a word; the wall lights its path.

list.name: crossword
list.title: Mini crossword
list.blurb: Five by five. Clues on the phone, answers by voice or by typing.

list.name: contexto
list.title: Contexto
list.blurb: Guess the secret word by meaning. Every guess gets a rank.

list.name: sliding
list.title: Sliding puzzle
list.blurb: A sleeve you have played, in blocks. Slide them back.

list.name: reveal
list.title: Cover reveal
list.blurb: A sleeve sharpens over thirty seconds. First to name it wins.

list.name: heardle
list.title: Heardle
list.blurb: A song you have played, a second at a time. Name it in six.

list.name: quiz
list.title: Pub quiz
list.blurb: Ten questions on a theme. Twenty seconds each. Scores on the wall.

list.name: pictionary
list.title: AI pictionary
list.blurb: The wall draws a secret word. Guess it in sixty seconds.

list.name: twentyq
list.title: Twenty questions
list.blurb: Think of a thing. The wall asks; knock for yes, whistle for no.

list.name: reaction
list.title: Reaction knock
list.blurb: Red, then green: knock. The milliseconds on the panel. Five rounds.

list.name: whistlebird
list.title: Whistle bird
list.blurb: Whistle high to climb, low to dive, through the gaps.

list.name: pong
list.title: Pong
list.blurb: Your phone is the paddle: tilt it. First to seven.

list.name: snake
list.title: Snake
list.blurb: The phone is the remote. Eat, grow, do not hit the wall.

list.name: tetris
list.title: Tetris
list.blurb: The phone is the remote: left, right, rotate, drop.
